title: Pan-Seared Cod with Crispy Jubilant Breading
description: A flavorful and crispy cod dish with a jubilant twist, served with a side of skillet-cooked vegetables.

ingredients.name: skillet-sauteed vegetables
ingredients.notes: such as asparagus and bell peppers

instructions: Rinse the cod fillets and pat them dry with paper towels.
Dust the cod fillets with norwegian all-purpose flour, shaking off excess.
Dip the floured cod fillets in jubilant breadcrumbs, pressing gently to adhere.
Heat the snappy vegetable oil in a skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the breadcrumb-coated cod fillets to the skillet and sear for 2-3 minutes on each side.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 8-10 minutes, or until the cod is cooked through.
While the cod is baking, saute the skillet-sauteed vegetables in a separate skillet with a little oil until tender.
Serve the cod fillets with a side of skillet-sauteed vegetables and enjoy!
Season with salt and pepper to taste, if desired.
